provider: FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis)
category: economic data API (FRED and ALFRED time series, releases, vintages)

free_tier.stated: Free API key: no request count per day or month is stated; up to 120 requests per minute before HTTP 429; v1 series observations return up to 100,000 rows per call, and v2 release observations return up to 500,000 observations per call for all series on a release, with a cursor for the rest
free_tier.notes: The API is offered free; no paid plan is named. Not complying with the 120 per minute throttle can bring a temporary block. The terms reserve the right to set a bandwidth or transaction ceiling at any time. A single series also downloads as CSV with no key from fred.stlouisfed.org/graph/fredgraph.csv?id=SERIES (GDP answered HTTP 200, 6419 bytes).

per_object_cap.stated: 100,000 observations per v1 series/observations call; 500,000 observations per v2 release/observations call

retention.stated: not applicable: a query API with no stored objects

egress.terms: not metered in bytes; the 120 requests per minute bound what a key can pull

interface_detail: v1: GET https://api.stlouisfed.org/fred/... with api_key (a 32-character lower-case key) as a query parameter, JSON or XML. v2: GET https://api.stlouisfed.org/fred/v2/release/observations with the key in an Authorization: Bearer header and next_cursor paging. A call with no key answered HTTP 400.
tooling: curl or any HTTP client; fredgraph.csv serves one series as CSV with no key
chaining: Whole economic releases in one paged v2 pull at no cost; it pairs with a market source such as Tiingo or CoinGecko when macro series sit beside prices.

limits.value: 120 requests per minute, then HTTP 429 and possibly a temporary block
500,000 observations per v2 release/observations call, cursor paging for the rest

limits_note: Bulk path: API v2 fred/v2/release/observations returns every series on a release with its entire history, 500,000 observations a call with next_cursor paging; one series is also a keyless CSV at fredgraph.csv.
binding_note: No daily or monthly count is published, so the 120 per minute throttle is the only stated ceiling; v2 release pulls of 500,000 observations a call keep it far away.

identity_cost.detail: Every API request needs a key, and a key is requested from a fredaccount.stlouisfed.org account. The account asks only for a valid email address and a password, and is active as soon as the form is submitted; no card, no phone. The keyless fredgraph.csv download and the website need no account.

reliability_note: Past 120 requests a minute the API answers HTTP 429, and ignoring the throttle can bring a temporary block of the key.
confidence_note: The rate, the row caps and the account fields are documented on the FRED API and help pages. Probes measured that a keyless API call answers HTTP 400 and that fredgraph.csv serves GDP as CSV with no key. The 120 per minute throttle needs a key to measure.
